profile.summary: Poddar Housing and Development Limited engages in real estate development, construction, sale, and other related activities in India. The company was formerly known as Poddar Developers Limited and changed its name to Poddar Housing and Development Limited in January 2016. Poddar Housing and Development Limited was founded in 1690 and is based in Mumbai, India.
